messages:
maria-peopleops: heads up: internal transfer (IC -> IC). manager requesting comp bump + band change effective next pay. what do we need to avoid delaying payroll?

jake-engineering-manager: thanks. subject: Sam. current $150,000 -> proposed $166,000 (about 10.7%). requested effective 2026-04-01. req submitted in Lattice. what's the checklist?

maria-peopleops: checklist: 1) one-paragraph manager evidence summary, 2) cost_center & headcount tag (replacement vs add), 3) requested effective date, 4) approvals attached in HR as pdf. note: >=10% requires director signoff + people-ops + finance review per comp policy.

leo-payroll: timeline: payroll cutoff for next cycle is EOD Thu (files locked Fri 02:00 UTC). to make next pay, approvals ideally finalized by Thu noon PST so we can stage and validate. proration: if eff date not first of month we'll prorate by days; 2026-04-01 is full month.

finance-ops: please provide cost center and run-rate delta so we can mark budget impact.

jake-engineering-manager: cost_center: ENG-PLAT, headcount: replacement, run_rate_delta: $16,000 annual.

anya-peopleops: i'll open exec loop now for director signoff. once approvals are in, attach PDF to /hr/comp_changes/2227005555.pdf so payroll can ingest.

maria-peopleops: quick note: if equity/grant schedule needs updating, include comp-admin in thread.

payroll-bot: Payroll intake received for request 2227005555 1 status: staged pending approvals. reference PR-2026-7222.
